001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Temporary adjustment (temp basal rate or temp control rate) activated.
009 */
010@HistoryLogProps(
011    opCode = 565,
012    displayName = "Temp Adjustment Activated",
013    internalName = "LID_TEMP_ADJUSTMENT_ACTIVATED"
014)
015public class TempAdjustmentActivatedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private int requestedPercent;
018    private int tempBasalPercent;
019    private long duration;
020    private int requestedAdjustmentType;
021    private int tempRateId;
022
023    public TempAdjustmentActivatedHistoryLog() {}
024    public TempAdjustmentActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
025        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
026    }
027
028    public TempAdjustmentActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int requestedPercent, int tempBasalPercent, long duration, int requestedAdjustmentType, int tempRateId) {
029        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
030        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, requestedPercent, tempBasalPercent, duration, requestedAdjustmentType, tempRateId);
031        parse(cargo);
032    }
033
034    public TempAdjustmentActivatedHistoryLog(int requestedPercent, int tempBasalPercent, long duration, int requestedAdjustmentType, int tempRateId) {
035        this(0, 0, requestedPercent, tempBasalPercent, duration, requestedAdjustmentType, tempRateId);
036    }
037
038    public int typeId() {
039        return 565;
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * <table border="1">
044     * <caption>Parsed fields for TempAdjustmentActivatedHistoryLog:</caption>
045     * <tr><td><code>requestedPercent</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
046     * <tr><td><code>tempBasalPercent</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
047     * <tr><td><code>duration</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
048     * <tr><td><code>requestedAdjustmentType</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
049     * <tr><td><code>tempRateId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
050     * </table>
051     */
052    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
053        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
054        this.cargo = raw;
055        parseBase(raw);
056        this.requestedPercent = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
057        this.tempBasalPercent = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
058        this.duration = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
059        this.requestedAdjustmentType = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
060        this.tempRateId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
061    }
062
063    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
064        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
065    }
066
067    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int requestedPercent, int tempBasalPercent, long duration, int requestedAdjustmentType, int tempRateId) {
068        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
069            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(565, 0),
070            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
071            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
072            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedPercent),
073            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(tempBasalPercent),
074            new byte[]{0, 0, 0, 0},
075            Bytes.toUint32(duration),
076            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedAdjustmentType),
077            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(tempRateId)));
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * @return requested percent
082     */
083    public int getRequestedPercent() {
084        return requestedPercent;
085    }
086    /**
087     * @return temp basal percent
088     */
089    public int getTempBasalPercent() {
090        return tempBasalPercent;
091    }
092    /**
093     * @return duration, in milliseconds
094     */
095    public long getDuration() {
096        return duration;
097    }
098    /**
099     * @return raw requested adjustment type, see {@link RequestedAdjustmentType}
100     */
101    public int getRequestedAdjustmentType() {
102        return requestedAdjustmentType;
103    }
104    public RequestedAdjustmentType getRequestedAdjustmentTypeEnum() {
105        return RequestedAdjustmentType.fromId(requestedAdjustmentType);
106    }
107    /**
108     * @return the temp rate ID
109     */
110    public int getTempRateId() {
111        return tempRateId;
112    }
113
114    public enum RequestedAdjustmentType {
115        TEMP_BASAL_RATE_GUI(0),
116        UNUSED_OBE(1),
117        TEMP_BASAL_RATE_BLE(2),
118        TEMP_CONTROL_RATE_BLE(3)
119
120        ;
121        private final int id;
122        RequestedAdjustmentType(int id) {
123            this.id = id;
124        }
125
126        public static RequestedAdjustmentType fromId(int id) {
127            for (RequestedAdjustmentType r : values()) {
128                if (r.id == id) {
129                    return r;
130                }
131            }
132            return null;
133        }
134
135        public int getId() {
136            return id;
137        }
138    }
139}
